'''Gold Four''' was the call sign of the fourth member of [[Gold Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Gold Four.

==History==
The [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lepira/Legends|Lepira]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CCGLL" /> Flying point for [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]],<ref name="CCGG4" /> Lepira was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] with the rest of his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], save for [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]].<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

Later, an [[Alliance of Free Planets]] pilot designated Gold Four fought against [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] forces in the [[Second Battle of Endor]].<ref name="SW100" />

During a simulation exercise to qualify for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Wraith Squadron|new squadron]], [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] used the call sign of Gold Four.<ref name="XWWS" />
